project: Project Sagar — 2D Fighting Game Animation Production
batch_name: Victory, Defeat, KO & Taunt (Final Character Animation Batch)

animations.gameplay_purpose: Match-win celebration expressing Sagar's confidence, warmth, and musical personality without dancing or props.
animations.starting_and_finishing_pose_descriptions: Starts from combat completion stance (F1), relaxes shoulders (F2), performs a chest-tap & finger-snap spawning a subtle golden-cyan eighth note (F3–F4), raises his fist with a smile (F5), and holds a commanding relaxed victory stance (F6).
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: F1 connects smoothly from Batch 1 standing guard or Batch 2/4 attack recoveries; F4 musical note matches Batch 4's golden-cyan palette; F6 is stable for victory screen hold.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Match-loss standing exhaustion and disappointment reaction, distinct from hit stun and KO.
animations.starting_and_finishing_pose_descriptions: Starts as defensive posture drops on match loss (F1), shoulders slump (F2), bends forward catching breath with hands near knees (F3), bows head in disappointment (F4), and holds a grounded defeated standing pose (F5).
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: F1 connects cleanly from neutral/post-hit standing states; both bare feet remain planted at y=272; F5 holds indefinitely on defeat screen.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Decisive match-ending knockout collapse ending in a permanent unconscious ground state.
animations.starting_and_finishing_pose_descriptions: Starts with sharp backward knockout jolt (F1), knees buckle (F2), loses balance tipping backward (F3–F4), hits the floor flat on his back head-left/feet-right (F5), and rests motionless unconscious on the ground (F6).
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: F6 grounded supine silhouette along y=272 is sized to match Sagar's canonical scale for visual compatibility with Batch 3 sagar_27_knockdown_fall_6f.png F6 (recommend side-by-side footprint verification in Animation Lab).

animations.gameplay_purpose: Short, confident, playful music-inspired in-combat taunt showing Sagar's rhythm and songwriting personality.
animations.starting_and_finishing_pose_descriptions: Starts from standing fighting guard (F1), snaps fingers to set a beat (F2–F3), spawns two small glowing golden-cyan musical notes near his fingers (F4), flashes a confident smirk (F5), and returns cleanly to standard standing guard (F6).
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: F1 and F6 match Batch 1 neutral standing guard directly for seamless mid-match playback; musical notes match revised Batch 4 palette.
